description: Set or clear the favorite subdomain shown as the VPS address. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

subdomainId.description: Subdomain id from get_vserver_dns; null or omitted clears the favorite.

name: set_vserver_favorite_subdomain
title: Set VPS Favorite Subdomain
